issue.title: Syncd container exit on broadcom platform

failure.body:
Broadcom platform, the sai seems not support 'SAI_API_PREFIX_COMPRESSION', API 53, the idx is out of range:

Failed log:
```
2024 Dec 13 <IPV6>.081087 sonic DEBUG syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_UNSPECIFIED:sai_log_set:783 SAI API Log set  API type 53 level 2 idx -536870806
2024 Dec 13 <IPV6>.084720 sonic INFO kernel: [  100.208616] syncd[17152]: segfault at 7fc05a1bfaa8 ip 00007fc0c84b11a5 sp 00007ffed4a76a30 error 6 in libsai.so.1.0[7fc0c82f8000+5e61000] likely on CPU 4 (core 0, socket 0)
2024 Dec 13 <IPV6>.084741 sonic INFO kernel: [  100.208636] Code: 00 83 fe 05 0f 87 db 00 00 00 8d 9f 35 00 00 e0 83 ff 34 89 fd 0f 46 df 85 c0 74 29 83 fb 48 0f 8f 10 01 00 00 48 63 db 31 c0 <45> 89 64 9d 00 48 83 c4 08 5b 5d 41 5c 41 5d 41 5e 41 5f c3 0f 1f
2024 Dec 13 <IPV6>.219187 sonic INFO swss#supervisord 2024-12-13 <IPV6>,218 INFO success: orchagent entered RUNNING state, process has stayed up for > than 1 seconds (startsecs)
```

resolution.title: [Broadcom] Fix syncd crash issue and upgrade xgs SAI to 12.3.2.2
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Fix #21680
##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**: 31426582

#### How I did it
- Re-compile SAI 12.3 with SAI header from https://github.com/opencomputeproject/SAI/tree/054085547c2042b95ab0fa1a75a44da3288b26bf

#### How to verify it
